Across t=0-8s, items drift/rotate (squiggle, chat bubble) and the blue character's eyes change to closed lines at 1.8s: idle float plus blink.
Card micro-demos change between captures ('Back Up Now' vs 'Backing Up', 'Normal ~60 Secs' vs 'Fast ~30 Secs' vs 'Urgent ~15 Secs', token icons swapping).
Heading holds its left position across several frames while the right-column detail cards move up: sticky left column (desktop only; stacks on mobile).
Tweet rows are offset differently between frames and full page; possibly a marquee (inferred).

reduced_motion: Hero looks the same as the settled normal hero; running_animations 46 normal vs 59 reduced (more under reduce), so idle animation is not suppressed.
